title: Lazar's missing records and the Los Alamos phone book
summary: George Knapp tells of Lazar's missing records and the Los Alamos phone book, about 1982-1989 at Los Alamos, New Mexico, and reports it citing named sources. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Los Alamos National Laboratory, New Mexico

tellings.quote: mistaken or were lying. A 1982 phone book from the lab lists Lazar right there among the other scientists and technicians.

plain: A journalist, George Knapp, tells of a man named Bob Lazar, whose claim to have worked as a scientist has been doubted because records of his past seemed to be missing. Knapp says a 1982 phone book from Los Alamos, a US government laboratory in New Mexico, lists Lazar right there among the other scientists and technicians, so those who said he never worked there were mistaken or lying.
